name: Commercial internet
note: Email, the web, the first online shops.

name: Broadband
note: Always-on internet in most homes. Unlocks online video and social media.

name: Social media
note: The feed arrives. Scandals travel in hours, not days.

name: Smartphones
note: A computer in every pocket. The press goes mobile.

name: Deep learning
note: Machines learn to see and hear.

name: Language models
note: AI writes and codes. The first labour-shock forecasts.

name: AI agents
note: Software that does office work end to end.

name: Self-driving freight
note: 3.5 million driving jobs at risk; freight costs fall 20–35%.

name: General-purpose robots
note: Robots in warehouses, kitchens and care homes.

name: AI-run research
note: AI systems run experiments. Every other lane speeds up.

name: Transformative AI?
note: The widest forecast in the game. The forecast itself is a political issue.

name: AI Transition Fund
note: Wage insurance and retraining. Softens the labour shock.

name: Automation dividend
note: A share of automation profits paid to every adult. Needs: General-purpose robots.

name: Combined-cycle gas
note: Efficient gas plants replace old coal.

name: Hydrogen cars
note: Much hyped. Historically, it did not arrive; the forecast says so.

name: Shale drilling
note: Cheap gas. America becomes an energy exporter; coal declines.

name: Solar at grid parity
note: Solar becomes the cheapest new power in most states.

name: Mass-market electric cars
note: Petrol demand peaks.

name: Grid batteries
note: Sunshine at night. Wind and solar firm up.

name: Enhanced geothermal
note: Clean power anywhere you can drill.

name: Small modular reactors
note: Factory-built nuclear plants.

name: Carbon removal at scale
note: Pulling CO₂ out of the air for under $150 a tonne.

name: Fusion pilot plant
note: The first plant to put fusion power on the grid. Maybe.

name: Carbon price
note: Every tonne pays. Emissions fall; petrol rises.

name: HIV antiretrovirals
note: A death sentence becomes a chronic illness.

name: Human genome
note: The map of human DNA, finished.

name: Gene editing
note: Cut and paste DNA. Cures, and new ethics fights.

name: mRNA vaccines
note: A vaccine designed in two days.

name: GLP-1 drugs
note: Obesity falls; health spending bends.

name: AI diagnosis
note: Better than most doctors at reading scans.

name: Cancer vaccines
note: Personalised vaccines against tumours.

name: Ageing drugs
note: Healthy lifespan +3–6 years. Pensions strain.

name: Lab-grown organs
note: No more transplant waiting lists.

name: Medicine price cap
note: Caps what patients pay for key drugs.

name: Precision weapons
note: GPS-guided munitions.

name: Armed drones
note: War by remote control.

name: Cyber command
note: The fifth domain of war.

name: Hypersonic missiles
note: Too fast to intercept, for now.

name: Drone swarms
note: Thousands of cheap drones, one mind.

name: Space missile tracking
note: Satellites that see every launch.

name: Quantum-safe encryption
note: Secrets that survive the quantum computer.

name: Laser missile defence
note: Shooting down missiles for dollars a shot.

name: Code-breaking quantum computer
note: Every unprotected secret becomes readable.

name: Autonomous weapons treaty
note: A human decides every strike. If the others sign.
